subject: Charged twice for March
body: I see two charges of $49 on my card for the March subscription. Please refund the duplicate one.

subject: Filing a chargeback
body: You have billed me for three months after I cancelled. If this is not fixed today I am filing a chargeback with my bank.

subject: Invoice with VAT number
body: Could you send our last invoice again with our company VAT number on it? Our accountant needs it for the quarter.

subject: Renewal at old price
body: Our plan renewed at the old rate. During the call in June we were told the new discounted rate would apply from this renewal.

subject: Card declined at checkout
body: Every time I try to pay, my card is declined, but my bank says there is no block on their side. I can't complete the upgrade.

subject: Production API returning 500s
body: Since 09:10 UTC every call to /v2/orders returns HTTP 500. Our checkout is down for all of our customers.

subject: App crashes on launch
body: After updating the iOS app to 4.2 it crashes as soon as it opens. I can't get to any of my projects.

subject: CSV export takes forever
body: Exporting about 5,000 rows to CSV takes around ten minutes. It finishes eventually, it's just very slow.

subject: Setting up webhooks
body: How do I set up webhooks for new orders? I couldn't find it in the docs.

subject: Notes not syncing
body: My notes have not synced between my phone and laptop since yesterday. Really frustrated, I rely on this for work.

subject: Records missing after migration
body: After the migration last night roughly half of our project records are missing from the workspace. We need them back.

subject: Locked out after changing phone
body: I changed my phone and now I can't get past two-factor authentication. I have no access to my backup codes.

subject: Change my email address
body: How do I change the email address on my profile?

subject: Reset email never arrives
body: I'm trying to sign in on my new laptop but the password reset email never arrives. I tried three times. I'm still signed in on my old machine.

subject: Someone took over my account
body: Someone changed my password and is sending messages to my contacts from my account. Please stop them.

subject: Delete my data
body: Please delete my account and all personal data you hold about me, as required under GDPR.

subject: Quote for 50 seats
body: We are evaluating tools for our team. What would pricing look like for 50 seats on an annual contract?

subject: Nonprofit discount
body: Do you offer a discount for registered nonprofits?

subject: Demo before Friday
body: Could we book a demo for our operations team sometime before Friday? We are deciding next week.

subject: Renewal quote for legal review
body: Our contract ends at the end of next month. We need a renewal quote soon so our legal team can review it.

subject: Love the new dashboard
body: The new dashboard is fantastic, much easier to find things. Great work!

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Feature request: please add a dark mode. My eyes would thank you.

subject: No reply for two weeks
body: I've emailed three times over two weeks and nobody has replied. This is unacceptable for a paid service.

subject: I want to speak to a manager
body: I want to speak to a manager about how my last case was handled.

subject: Prorated refund for annual plan
body: We have moved to another tool. Could we get a prorated refund for the remaining eight months of our annual plan?

subject: Uploads over 10MB fail
body: Uploading any file over 10MB fails with 'Request entity too large'. Smaller files upload fine.

subject: Slack alerts stopped
body: Our Slack integration stopped posting alerts yesterday. The on-call team depends on these notifications.

subject: Inviting a colleague
body: How do I invite a colleague to our workspace?

subject: Thanks to Maria
body: Just wanted to say thank you to Maria for her help yesterday, she sorted everything out quickly.

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled my subscription last month but I was charged again today. Please refund it.

subject: Other customers' data visible
body: If you change the ID in the export URL you get other customers' invoices. This looks like a serious data exposure.

subject: Notice from our lawyer
body: Our lawyer will be in touch regarding your breach of the service agreement.

subject: API rate limits
body: Is there a rate limit on the public API, and is it per key or per account?

subject: Nobody can sign in via SSO
body: Since this morning nobody on our 40-person team can sign in through our Okta SSO. Everyone is blocked.
